accounts.approve: Tell me what you found before you write anything: how many of each, with a few examples. Wait for my approval and leave out whatever I reject.
accounts.none: If no account is connected, say so in one sentence, offer to connect Gmail, Outlook or LinkedIn with connect_messaging_account, and carry on with empty lists.
accounts.propose: From them, pick the people, organizations and open requests or deals that belong in the new lists, each with the address or profile it came from. Skip newsletters, no-reply senders, notifications and anyone already in the workspace.
accounts.read: If accounts are connected, read the recent email threads and LinkedIn conversations with get_messaging_threads, and the coming meetings with get_calendars where a list tracks meetings.
accounts.write: Then create the approved records with import_crm_records, with email addresses, phone numbers and profiles as identities in the contact details field, so their conversations link to them by themselves. Link a conversation to a deal or organization with manage_conversation_records only where it clearly belongs there.

availability.routine: an assistant routine that runs on a schedule
availability.unavailable: not available yet, do not set up

contactDetails: Email addresses, phone numbers and social profiles go only into the built-in contact details field (field type channels, shown in the app as Phone, email & social), never into a text or link field. That is how messages and conversations link to the right record by themselves.

defaultView.rule: A view marked as default is the list's built-in view that shows every record: set it up there instead of creating a second view, then select it when you are done so the list opens on it.

fieldTypes.channels: contact channels: email, phone and social profiles

headings.connectedAccounts: Fill the lists from my connected accounts
headings.knowledgePages: Knowledge Base pages (outlines only, filled with my own facts)

procedure.askQuestions: Ask the questions at the end first. Leave every unknown empty instead of guessing.
procedure.checkAccounts: Check which accounts are connected (connectedAccounts in get_workspace_context, or manage_connected_accounts with list): Gmail, Outlook, other email through IMAP and LinkedIn.
procedure.describePlan: Describe the plan below in plain words, adapted to my answers, and wait for my approval before you change anything.
procedure.readContext: Call get_workspace_context and read the Operating Guide, the existing lists, fields, views and wiki pages.
procedure.reuse: Reuse what already exists. Never create a second list for something the workspace already tracks.

recordDetails.order: Put each list's fields in the order given above with configure_record_model (the field position), so every teammate sees the most important fields first on the detail page.
recordDetails.pins: Then pin the stage, the next date and the key amount of each list in your own detail layout with manage_record_detail_layout. Pins are personal, so tell me which ones the team should pin as well.

relationship: {source} link to {target} (shown as {sourceLabel} on {source} and {targetLabel} on {target})

roadRules.neverInvent: Never invent prices, amounts, dates or names. Leave them empty until I tell you.
roadRules.noSamples: Create no sample, demo or placeholder records.
roadRules.readBack: After the build, read the result back and tell me what exists and what you skipped.
roadRules.sendNothing: Send nothing: no emails, messages, invitations or posts. Drafts only, and only when I ask.
roadRules.sensitiveData: Keep sensitive personal data out of the workspace unless I ask for it.

routineAllowance.limited: The assistant routine allowance of your plan is {count} per user, and creating more is refused. Create only the first {count} of the numbered routines below, in that order, since the most useful come first. List the others as optional without creating them, and do not delete anything to make room.
routineAllowance.none: Your plan includes no assistant routines. Create none of the routines below and list them all as optional.

routinesIntro: Propose these as a set. Set up only the ones marked as available and tell me about the rest.

sharing.views: Create each view with manage_data_views and share it with the whole workspace (share with visibility workspace), so every teammate can open it.
sharing.widgets: Create each widget on the main dashboard with manage_widgets and isTemplate true, so the whole team sees it.

workspace.connected: You are already connected to the Customermates workspace that will hold this template. Work in it and do not create another one.
workspace.connectedAt: This workspace already exists and you are connected to it through MCP at {mcpUrl}. Pass workspace {workspace} on every tool call, and work in this workspace and in no other.
workspace.existsAt: This workspace already exists, but your assistant is not connected to it yet. Connect it through MCP at {mcpUrl} and sign in with my Customermates account. Until it is connected, ask me to finish the connection before you change anything. Then pass workspace {workspace} on every tool call, and work in this workspace and in no other.
workspace.unconnected: Work in the Customermates workspace you are connected to through MCP. If you are not connected to one yet, ask me to connect you before you change anything.
